notes.title: Halloween Update is here! (Update 1.16)
notes.notes:
Hello my friends!

The new Halloween update (Version 1.16) is now available for Suicide Guy Deluxe Plus, check it out!
It includes the first part of the DLC (the first 3 new levels) and more!

Check out all the features!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1972820/Suicide_Guy_Deluxe_Plus/

Includes:

- 3 new exclusive levels!
- new option mode for players with cerebral palsy to unlock the mouse cursor 
- Performance improvements
- graphics enhancements

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42350833/11326c8bcaf8b973f7132dc83caa89aaf6f626d0.png[/img]

Have fun!
Chubby Pixel
